content: Prisma ORM latest major is v7 (7.8.0 per npm registry), released 2026, replacing the Rust query engine with a TypeScript/WebAssembly runtime: ~3x faster queries, ~90% smaller bundles, ~70% faster typechecking. Prisma 7 requires an explicit 'output' path in the generator block and client must be imported from that generated path rather than @prisma/client default. Prisma Postgres / prisma bootstrap CLI flow improved in 7.7.
